Name: Trampoline
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[youtube]LcskBlAymiY[/youtube]


With this mod, you can transform any piece of 2x2 furniture into a trampoline by hovering the mouse over it and pressing the hotkey
(default [b]T[/b]).

You can bounce on a trampoline by sitting on the  transformed furniture.

You can bounce higher by holding down the higher key (default [b]Up Arrow[/b]).

You can bounce lower by holding down the lower key (default [b]Down Arrow[/b]).

You can bounce slower by holding down the slower key (default [b]Left Arrow[/b]).

You can bounce lower by holding down the faster key (default [b]Right Arrow[/b]).

You can reskin the trampoline using Content Patcher, targeting the following path:

[b]aedenthorn.Trampoline/trampoline[/b]


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
